title: Currents annihilate test forms supported off their support
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ, every set U ⊆ ℝ^P, every current T ∈ GeometricCurrentOn U n and every test form ω ∈ TestFormOn U n (C^∞, compact support, tsupport ω ⊆ U): if tsupport ω is disjoint from spt T = U ∖ zeroRegion(T) (zeroRegion(T) = union of all open W with closure W compact, closure W ⊆ U and T(η) = 0 for every test form η with tsupport η ⊆ W), then T(ω) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n)) T.support → T ω = 0
